messages:
maria-cs: Crescent reports intermittent 401s and short 429 bursts while booting our SDK in staging after they rolled a new edge/WAF rule. Ticket C-421.
liam-eng: Do we have a minimal failing request and is it many hosts or one?
maria-cs: Single host for now. Sanitized example:
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}
They see a 401 about 1/10 requests and 429 spikes for ~30s windows.
zara-ps: Two likely causes: (1) proxy/WAF trimming or dropping Authorization header, (2) very short token TTL causing synchronized refreshes. What's their TTL?
maria-cs: TTL is 15s; they use pre-warmed serverless workers so refreshes line up.
sam-sre: Short TTL + concurrency = stampede of auth refreshes -> transient 429s. Also proxies sometimes drop auth header -> 401. Ask them to add an X-Debug-Id and run a curl probe so we can correlate.
liam-eng: Provide this probe:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug-Id:probe123" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"probe"}'
We need the raw upstream headers/response.
maria-cs: They ran it. Sample logs (tokens redacted):
[2026-03-21T09:20:13Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe123 req=abc123
[2026-03-21T09:20:13Z] 401 Unauthorized X-Debug-Id=probe124 req=abc124 auth=missing
[2026-03-21T09:20:14Z] 429 Too Many Requests X-Debug-Id=probe125 req=abc125 rate=client_concurrency
[2026-03-21T09:20:15Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe126 req=abc126
sam-sre: Looks like Authorization is sometimes missing. Any CDN/WAF rules recently changed?
maria-cs: Yes, they updated WAF rule groups right before the failures. They temporarily disabled suspect rules and retried: 10/10 200s and far fewer 429s after they added jitter to token refresh.
liam-eng: If nginx is in the chain ensure `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;`. Short-term fix: increase TTL to ~60s and add jitter. Longer-term: fix WAF to forward Authorization unchanged.
zara-ps: I'll draft a short onboarding note (nginx/envoy snippets, TTL + jitter guidance) and share it with them.
maria-cs: I'll update the ticket with the mitigation steps and offer a temporary elevated rate window for the ramp if they want. Thanks all :thumbsup:
